nodes.title: 🪄 Adetailer: Your Personal Face-Fixer
widgets_values:
Adetailer is like the friend who tells you when you’ve got something in your teeth but instead of embarrassing you, it **fixes** the problem for you. 🤗

📸 Step 1: Load up an image.

⚡ Step 2: Run 🙂

You can switch the Detector Model to bbox/hand for hand fixes. Just note: it masks the hand’s shape, so you’ll usually get the same finger count and pose as the original.

Tip 💡: Denoise strength matters here too. Tweak it!

nodes.title: Tweak Smart, Not Hard
widgets_values:
Look, you don’t need to study for a ComfyUI adetailer settings exam. 🥲

Just pay attention to the usual suspects especially denoise strength.

Everything else? Meh.
Unless you like overthinking sliders at 3AM. I don’t judge. 🤖✌️

💡 Pro Tip: The wildcard box is to force variety. For example, "blonde, brunette, redhead" one of those will be chosen randomly each time you hit "Run".

nodes.title: Global Models (Inpainting Edition!)
widgets_values: You already know how this works, but now we’ve got a shiny new Inpainting Model to load. ✨ **Just like before**, pick between GGUF or FP8.

nodes.title: Update Notes
widgets_values:
I highly recommend trying Schnell with  Advanced Upscale. Since these are more detail passes, doing it at 1 to 4 steps is much better than 10 to 20 with normal Dev/Krea. Don't forget to adjust denoise strength as you change steps. 

Note that the scheduler *karras* reacts weirdly with denoise values but the sweet spot is much better when it comes to upscaling.

I can't really get good results with Adetailer but note that steps, sampler, scheduler, and denoise are the ones to change. The rest are ideal values. 

I was expecting to have to write more here but that's it. 🙂

nodes.title: ⚡ Flux Advanced (Level 2):
widgets_values:
Welcome back, **Noodler** 🍜. Yes, I'm still calling you that.

Today, Max has us **wiggling** into the deep end with Adetailer, Inpainting, and Outpainting, aka the holy trinity of AI touch-ups. 🖌️ With a side of Upscaling.

Level 1 was your cozy island 🏝️ Level 2 drops you into the jungle 🌴. Don’t worry, I’m still here, still noodling, still slightly unhinged. 😜

➡️ Follow the noodle!

nodes.title: Expand Your Horizons (Literally) 🖼️
widgets_values:
You’ve got an image. It’s great. But what if you want… **more**? That’s where Outpainting comes in. ☝️

📸 Step 1: Load your image.

📏 Step 2: In the Expansion Size node, set how many pixels to expand.

⚡ Step 3: Generate

Boom your image just grew (after a long wait...). Like stretching pizza dough, but with pixels. 🍕 Is it kinda mushy? Drives Max up the wall. Z Image Turbo outpainting is better.

nodes.title: 🎨 Inpainting (Fix AI Nightmares)
widgets_values:
🎨 Inpainting is your "undo" button when AI decides to bless you with three-armed nightmares. Or to make questionable changes to anything. 🤨

Step 1: Load an image. Click it. Select the striped circle in the top bar popup to enter mask editor.

Step 2: Mask area

Step 3: Generate

Default Flux guidance for Flux Fill (not Flux Dev) is 30.
Still can poke it, prod it, and mess with it if your heart desires.

Note that inpaint and outpaint use the Flux Fill model not Dev/Krea/Schnell.

nodes.title: The Real Deal
widgets_values:
This is where the **real** upscaling magic lives.

Pick your upscale model. Don’t stress about being picky, Flux is gonna clean up the mess anyway. 

Tweak settings to your hearts desires. Like denoise, steps, sampler, or scheduler.

nodes.title: End of the Road?
widgets_values:
You're either dedicated or you've gotten lost clicking noodles and somehow ended up here. Either way, **respect**. 🫡

So, what's next? 🎯

Go forth and experiment wildly or brace yourself, because Level 3 is packing a lot. 

- Redux, use the style of an image as a prompt. 

- Depth, strip the soul out of an image and prompt for what Flux should fill it with. 

- Canny, Depth's weird cousin that likes edge maps instead of depth maps. 

- And more 🙂

As always, it's on Max's [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/maxedout99) 🙏

nodes.title: End of the Road?
widgets_values: Without Power Users, I couldn’t justify the time investment all of this takes. So just know that if you subscribe, you're doing more than unlocking Mega Workflows and Installers. You're making it possible for me to make the free stuff as well. 🙏
